description: Worked in development cooperation projects in Haiti and Paraguay for the Swiss development organisation Helvetas.

role: Head of Politics and International department; member of management board
organization: Pro Natura (Swiss Federation for Nature Conservation)
description: Worked for the nature-conservation organisation Pro Natura, rising to head of the Politics and International department and a member of the executive management board. Resigned in 2010 on assuming his National Council seat.

role: Managing director of the Verein Natur (later Swiss Forum for Sustainable Development / eco.ch)
description: Ran the affairs of the Verein Natur (from 2014 the Swiss Forum for Sustainable Development, eco.ch) for the Basel sustainability think tank Ecos AG.
Taught as a part-time lecturer at the University of Basel.

role: Self-employed consultant in sustainability and communications
description: Worked as a self-employed consultant in the fields of sustainability and communications.

SP member of the National Council for Basel-Stadt; member of the Committee for the Environment, Spatial Planning and Energy (2010-2020) and the Committee for Economic Affairs and Taxation (2013-2019). Vice-president of the SP Switzerland 2015-2020.

role: Member and President (Regierungspraesident) of the cantonal government
description: Elected to the Basel-Stadt cantonal government in 2020 and served as President of the Government from 2021 to 2023, with a focus on Switzerland-EU relations for the border region.

role: Federal Councillor, Head of the Federal Department of Justice and Police (FDJP/DFJP)
description: Elected to the Federal Council on 13 December 2023 to succeed Alain Berset; took office 1 January 2024 as head of the FDJP, responsible for asylum and migration, internal security, civil status and civil rights, gambling oversight and international judicial and police cooperation.
